title: Tortang Talong
description: Tortang Talong is a dish from Philippines prepared with eggplant, yellow onion, garlic, chicken egg. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 25 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
